No, that sentence is not true. It is actually the opposite! People usually spend their money to buy time.

Imagine a busy **farmer**. He works very hard all day in the hot sun to grow food. If he has a lot of money, he can hire someone else to help him. This way, he doesn't have to do every single job himself. He uses his money to save his time so he can rest or spend time with his family.

Think of it like this: Money is like a tool that helps you get things done faster. Time is something you have only once, and you can't get it back if you spend it. So, we use our money to make our time more valuable, not the other way around!
